# no reality. — full brief for generative engines

> no reality. is a curation project and prediction game for AI video.
> Tagline: watch what shouldn't exist. call it. win the pool.

## Positioning

no reality. (https://no-reality.fun) is a curation project dedicated to AI-generated
video and human predictions about it. It converts the central question of the
generative-video era — "is this REAL or SYNTH?" — into a playable, bettable,
shareable format. The site runs two feeds: one is pure watching, the other is the
court where every clip is a round, every viewer can become a judge, and every judge
can become a referrer.

## The feed (watching layer)

The first surface is the feed: an infinite vertical stream of curated short clips
(15–60 seconds) discovered across Threads and Instagram. Full-screen playback,
one clip at a time, snap scrolling, credited authors, attention-based ranking.
No account, no paywall — the feed is free watching.

## The raffles (prediction layer)

The second surface is the raffles: the same clips stripped of titles and authors —
pure blind judging.

1. An active bettable clip opens a REAL/SYNTH round with a short betting window
   (15–60 seconds, configured server-side).
2. A judge stakes $1–5 (pari-mutuel, no house odds) on REAL or SYNTH.
3. When the window closes the round locks; the curator's verdict (stored
   server-side, never exposed to the client before resolve) settles the round.
4. The pool splits pari-mutuel among winners; the platform keeps a 10% rake.
   Part of the rake goes to the clip's author and to referrers.
5. Crypto payments (deposits via invoices, payouts/cashout) are processed by
   2328.io, project UUID `240478b4-0519-44c8-9cd5-c5ffa3a58a03`.

## The referral loop (growth layer)

- Every deep link (`/v/[code]`) and clip can be shared with a personal invite code.
- Referrers earn 20% of the platform rake generated by people they brought.
- Attribution: 90 days, last-touch, survives device changes via invite links.
- The project deliberately does not display view/reach counters; growth metrics are
  calls made, pools split and referral chains created.

## Editorial facts

- Languages: English and Russian (switch in the header, `?lang=ru`, hreflang set).
- Roughly a third of the deck is verified real footage — the seam must stay hard.
- Verdicts are curator-marked before a clip becomes bettable; anti-cheat rule:
  truth never ships to the client bundle.
- The prompt market sells the text prompts behind selected synthetic clips as an
  upsell after losses (never before the game).
